standard.summary: sidecar 缺失/损坏时回退原版 npz
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Falls back to the original npz when the sidecar is missing or damaged
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: sidecar 缺失/损坏时回退原版 npz 而非崩训练。关闭=strict 硬失败。

advanced_en.principle: Falls back to the original npz instead of crashing training when a sidecar is missing/corrupt. Off = strict hard failure.
